text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Seven small political parties represented in the government-appointed Transitional National Council to merge into a new political coalition.
- Security forces launch a new offensive against "terrorists" in several regions around Algiers.

- The authorities plan to restructure government-controlled newspapers by spinning off El Moudjahid newspaper from its main printing press and dissolving Algerie-Actualite weekly and Essalam daily because of insolvency.
- The value of Algeria's oil and gas exports rose to $12.6 billion in 1996 compared to about $9.7 in 1995.
- Transitional National Council resumes session to vote on privatisation, party and elections laws.
